# Workspace Instructions

- This is a personal, non-affiliated marketplace search prototype.
- This is a personal-use prototype. OLX visible-page import is explicitly user-invoked and only reads the currently open public results page.
- Exact phrase mode passes the query in quotes, but marketplaces control how they interpret it.
- Keep external links pointed to marketplace-owned search or item pages and label them accurately.
- Never bypass authentication, CAPTCHAs, rate limits, anti-bot blocks, or other access controls. Stop a source if normal browser access is blocked.
- Keep imported data local; do not store listing results on a remote service.
- Run `npm run build` and `npm run lint` after code changes.
